                                                <h3>Case studies</h3>
                                                <div><a href="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/eche/standing-out-from-the-crowd-supporting-students-through-full-recognition-and-documenting-of-mobility-outcomes" target="_blank">"Standing out from the crowd" - supporting students through full recognition and documenting of mobility outcomes</a></div>
                                                <div><a href="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/eche/a-common-approach-to-ects-grade-conversion-ensuring-a-fair-assessment-of-student-performance-after-study-abroad" target="_blank">A common approach to ECTS grade conversion, ensuring a fair assessment of student performance after study abroad</a></div>
                                             </div>

                </div>
            </div>

                <div class="eche-officer-question-title-wrapper">
                    <div class="eche-report-title-icons-wrapper">
                                                 <div class="eche-report-officer-number">
                            <img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/eche-pdf/number-corner-orange-12.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">

                            <div class="eche-report-officer-number-text">12</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="eche-officer-question-icon"><img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/ECHE__OFFICERS_Q12.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">
</div>

                    <div class="eche-report-title-question-text-wrapper">
                        <div class="eche-officer-question"> Your institution issues a Diploma Supplement</div>
                        <div class="eche-report-button-js eche-report-detail-close"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle fa-3x"></i></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="eche-officer-question-wrapper eche-report-question-wrapper-show">
                    <div class="eche-report-border"></div>
                    <div classs="eche-officer-must">
                                                <h3>Must have</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">To all students, automatically, free of charge and in a major European language</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>This Supplement should include a record of the period of mobility under the Erasmus+ Programme. The 48 European countries taking part in the Bologna Process have agreed that each mobile graduate in their respective country should receive the Diploma Supplement (DS) automatically, free of charge and in at least one of the major European languages in addition to the national language. The HEI should issue a Diploma Supplement (or equivalent) to accompany every degree successfully completed by a student, using - where applicable - the template developed by the European Commission, the Council of Europe and UNESCO. The HEI's policy on issuing the Diploma Supplement should be published on its website.</p><p>The template for the Diploma Supplement is available at:<br><a href="http://ec.europa.eu/education/tools/diploma-supplement_en.htm">http://ec.europa.eu/education/tools/diploma-supplement_en.htm&nbsp;</a></p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-best">
                                                <h3>Best practices</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">That includes a record of the mobility period(s) carried out by the student under the Erasmus+ programme</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The information contained in the Transcript of Records from the Receiving Institution should also be included in the Diploma Supplement produced by the Sending Institution (at least for Sending Institutions located in Programme Countries), with the exact titles of the components that the student has followed abroad. Alongside modules or units taken at the sending HEI, the Diploma Supplement should list recognised modules, units and/or training activities undertaken during the student's mobility period and indicate the location of these mobility activities.<br>In the case of double, multiple or joint degrees, the Diploma Supplement should indicate the name and status of the partner HEIs awarding the degree and explain the respective language(s) of instruction and examination. In addition, an explanation should be provided about the grading and classification scheme agreed by the awarding HEIs. The template for the Diploma Supplement is available at:<br><a href="http://ec.europa.eu/education/tools/diploma-supplement_en.htm">http://ec.europa.eu/education/tools/diploma-supplement_en.htm</a>&nbsp;</p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-case">
                                                <h3>Case studies</h3>
                                                <div><a href="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/eche/the-diploma-supplement-a-tool-to-promote-international-recognition-and-transparency-of-academic-achievement" target="_blank">The Diploma Supplement – a tool to promote international recognition and transparency of academic achievement</a></div>
                                             </div>
                    <div class="eche-report-button-js eche-report-detail-close-text"><i class="fa fa-times fa-2x"></i><span>Close</span></div>
                </div>

                         <div class="eche-report-full-question-wrapper">
                <div class="eche-officer-question-title-wrapper">
                    <div class="eche-report-title-icons-wrapper">
                                                 <div class="eche-report-officer-number">
                            <img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/eche-pdf/number-corner-orange-13.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">

                            <div class="eche-report-officer-number-text">13</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="eche-officer-question-icon"><img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/ECHE__OFFICERS_Q13.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">
</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="eche-report-title-question-text-wrapper">
                        <div class="eche-officer-question"> Your institution promotes and recognises staff mobility</div>
                        <div class="eche-report-button-js eche-report-detail-close"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle fa-3x"></i></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="eche-officer-question-wrapper eche-report-question-wrapper-show">
                    <div class="eche-report-border"></div>
                    <div classs="eche-officer-must">
                                                <h3>Must have</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">By taking it into account in the assessment of their professional development </span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>Participation in international projects should be seen as an important aspect of the professional development of the staff and of the modernisation of the HEI and should, therefore, be considered a key component in staff evaluation practices.</p><p>The HEI should link its HR strategy to the objectives set out the internationalisation strategy for staff. For all staff who undertake a period of mobility, HR should be informed and provide support to ensure the identification of the professional development needs of the individual as well as setting out agreed career objectives for their period of mobility. This can be through prepared addendums to staff contracts or through less formal mechanisms of agreed objectives. The new objectives should become part of the normal system of staff evaluation or appraisal and be used in order to recognise the achievements of the staff during the period of mobility. This means that HR staff should be trained to ensure these additional objectives are formally evidenced and recorded in staff records and lead to other rewards and recognition.&nbsp;</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">Through, for example the reduction of the teaching load, promotion or pay rises</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>It is highly important to incentivise staff to participate in mobility activities. In order to support and encourage mobility, HEIs should provide a number of incentives to ensure that when staff return to the sending institution, they have long term career benefits. HEIs should acknowledge periods of mobility as a normal part of a career path. Staff working schedules and agreed objectives (in terms of research outputs and assessments) should be adapted to meet their new requirements. Temporary replacements should be found during the mobility period, where possible, to ensure continuity during the mobility period. Upon returning to the sending institution, incentives to maintain links with other institutions or networks should be put in place through providing the time to nurture new relationships (reduction in teaching or research loads, continued related objectives set in performance appraisals). The new objectives set with HR for the period of mobility should be ones which are explicitly recognised and rewarded through promotion, awards or pay rises. Additional cultural / language skills should be recognised as a component in any evaluation / assessment of the staff. This may be achieved by making it well-known that participation is a formal part of staff evaluation procedures, and may lead to improvements in both working conditions and promotion or broader career prospects.</p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-best">
                                                <h3>Best practices</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">By encouraging them to propose improvements to the institutional strategy for internationalisation and overarching structure, as well as for structural reform</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>One important form of recognition for staff, which is equally beneficial to the HEI is to encourage their involvement in improving internationalisation and structural reform within the institution. This includes the opportunity for staff to provide feedback into the management structures of departments and the overall institution. There should be a firm commitment - perhaps in writing - from the HEI to recognise and make use of constructive feedback as well as the appropriate forums for staff to engage with senior management to discuss their experiences and propose new ideas for improvement.&nbsp;</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">By inviting them to share new learning and teaching practices developed abroad with their peers in the institution</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The experience of staff should be valued and shared as an inspiration to others, by, for example, organising meetings and publishing articles where the mobile participants share their experience and the impact of mobility on their personal and professional development. Where staff are involved in teaching at host institutions, new learning and teaching practices can be brought back and shared with other staff members through seminars or presentations. Staff can be supported through the administrative and academic services to understand the skills they have acquired and how best to use them within their own institution.</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">By encouraging them to propose cooperation projects with their receiving organisation</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>Mobile staff bring back new partners, networks and ideas which can be of significant value for the HEI. Staff should be encouraged to propose and develop new or further cooperation projects between their receiving and sending institutions. This requires time and commitment, which need to be given formally by the sending institution, including, for example, additional support to write joint proposals.&nbsp;</p>                      </div>

                         <div class="eche-report-full-question-wrapper">
                <div class="eche-officer-question-title-wrapper">
                    <div class="eche-report-title-icons-wrapper">
                                                 <div class="eche-report-officer-number">
                            <img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/eche-pdf/number-corner-orange-14.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">

                            <div class="eche-report-officer-number-text">14</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="eche-officer-question-icon"><img class="eche-report-question-icon" src="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/profiles/custom/eac_profile/modules/eac_eche/images/ECHE__OFFICERS_Q14.png" width="100%" height="100%" alt="Question Icon" title="Question Icon" loading="lazy">
</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="eche-report-title-question-text-wrapper">
                        <div class="eche-officer-question"> With regards to the outcomes and experiences of Erasmus+ activities</div>
                        <div class="eche-report-button-js eche-report-detail-close"><i class="fa fa-plus-circle fa-3x"></i></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="eche-officer-question-wrapper eche-report-question-wrapper-show">
                    <div class="eche-report-border"></div>
                    <div classs="eche-officer-must">
                                                <h3>Must have</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">The results are monitored, evaluated and disseminated as a way to improve international cooperation and mobility activities</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>Linked with the overall internationalisation strategy of the institution, monitoring and evaluation of cooperation projects and Erasmus+ mobility is essential if HEIs are to learn from their experiences. Monitoring and evaluation is more than just measuring the number and types of outputs, it needs to include capturing information on the overall outcomes and experiences of the activities at the institutional and the individual level. Systematic monitoring and evaluation should therefore include more qualitative approaches, which expressly capture the experiences in a way which helps the institution to understand the added value of its involvement in these activities. Documenting and analysing the outcomes and experiences is only the first step. To learn from the approaches taken, and the benefits gained, institutions should take time to disseminate the findings of the cooperation projects and mobility periods through, for example, meetings, workshops and publications, social media, etc. These activities will embed good practice, help the institution to iteratively improve its approach and also feed back into the on-going monitoring and evaluation.</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">The results are used systematically for the benefit of your institution, providing internationalisation at home, hence enhancing intercultural competences of non-mobile students and staff</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The outcomes and experiences of cooperation and Erasmus+ mobility have a much wider impact than just improving mobile activities. All institutions have significant numbers of non-mobile staff and students who can benefit from the international experiences of others. As part of the monitoring and evaluation processes, HEIs should consider the impact which can be specifically made on non-mobile staff and students, giving them “internationalisation at home experiences”. This includes building international competences, cultural awareness, virtual mobility opportunities, inviting international lecturers and embedding student projects with an international focus into the curricula, and providing opportunities for local students to work together with incoming mobile participants in e.g. project work, to ensure that local students benefit from the presence of mobile students at their institution. This fits with the activities of disseminating the overall outcomes and experiences of the cooperation projects and Erasmus+ mobility, though tailored to a different audience. It should take into account the professional development needs of the staff at the HEI and the perspectives of non-mobile students.&nbsp;</p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-best">
                                                <h3>Best practices</h3>
                                                <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">The results are exploited and disseminated, by providing participants with the results of cooperation projects and Erasmus+ mobility opportunities (e.g. presentations) to share funding possibilities</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The dissemination of outcomes is an integral part of mobility projects. Good practice would be to ensure that the dissemination is built into the support measure and participants in projects and mobility actions are allocated adequate time, resources and space to disseminate their experiences and exploit project results. This includes opportunities to share new knowledge and to highlight new opportunities (including funding) which have arisen from the new relationships formed. In order to do this, HEIs should provide support functions such as web platforms to collect results or opportunities to present results at the institutional or departmental level, as relevant.&nbsp;</p>                         <span class="eche-officer-user-answer">After the mobility Erasmus+ participants have the opportunity to present their newly acquired competences</span>
                        <h4>Guidance note:</h4>
                         <p>The study entitled ‘Effects of mobility on the skills and employability of students and the internationalisation of higher education institutions’ showcases how mobility can contribute to the internationalisation of higher education institutions, including the impacts on teaching methods, cooperation between HEIs and perception of staff more generally. Therefore the dissemination of outcomes is an integral part of mobility projects. Good practice would be to ensure that the dissemination is built into the support measure and participants in projects and mobility actions are allocated adequate time, resources and space to disseminate their experiences and exploit project results. This includes opportunities to share new knowledge and to highlight new opportunities (including funding) which have arisen from the new relationships formed. In order to do this, HEIs should provide support functions such as web platforms to collect results or opportunities to present results at the institutional or departmental level, as relevant.&nbsp;</p>                      </div>
                    <div class="eche-officer-case">
                                                <h3>Case studies</h3>
                                                <div><a href="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/eche/capitalising-on-the-outcomes-and-experiences-of-erasmus-activities" target="_blank">Capitalising on the outcomes and experiences of Erasmus+ activities</a></div>

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in Berlin suchen wir Sie zum n\u00e4chstm\u00f6glichen Zeitpunkt als \u201eHausmeister Haustechnik (m\/w\/d)<\/strong>\u201c.<\/p>

Aufgaben<\/strong><\/h2>
  • Als Hausmeister in der Geb\u00e4udetechnik (m\/w\/d) betreuen Sie Geb\u00e4ude und technische Anlagen und sorgen f\u00fcr einen zuverl\u00e4ssigen Betrieb <\/li>
  • Zudem f\u00fchren Sie regelm\u00e4\u00dfige Kontroll- und Inspektionsrundg\u00e4nge durch und erkennen technische St\u00f6rungen fr\u00fchzeitig <\/li>
  • Dar\u00fcber hinaus \u00fcbernehmen Sie kleinere Reparaturen und unterst\u00fctzen bei der Wartung und Instandhaltung der Geb\u00e4udetechnik <\/li>
  • Zus\u00e4tzlich melden und koordinieren Sie notwendige Instandsetzungen und stimmen sich hierzu mit der zust\u00e4ndigen Objektleitung ab <\/li>
  • Dabei achten Sie auf die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorgaben und stellen eine zuverl\u00e4ssige Ausf\u00fchrung der technischen Leistungen sicher<\/li> <\/ul>

    Qualifikation<\/strong><\/h2>
    • Grundlage bildet eine handwerkliche Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Anlagenmechaniker SHK (m\/w\/d), Elektroniker f\u00fcr Energie- und Geb\u00e4udetechnik (m\/w\/d) oder Mechatroniker (m\/w\/d) <\/li>
    • Besonders passend ist Berufserfahrung als Haustechniker (m\/w\/d), Technischer Hausmeister (m\/w\/d) oder Anlagenmechaniker (m\/w\/d) in der Betreuung von Geb\u00e4uden und technischen Anlagen <\/li>
    • Idealerweise bringen Sie Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Sanit\u00e4r, Heizung, Klima, K\u00e4lte oder Elektrotechnik mit <\/li>
    • Zus\u00e4tzlich verf\u00fcgen Sie \u00fcber grundlegende EDV- und MS-Office-Kenntnisse sowie einen F\u00fchrerschein der Klasse B <\/li>
    • Wichtig sind handwerkliches Geschick, eine selbstst\u00e4ndige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine ausgepr\u00e4gte Service- und Kundenorientierung<\/li> <\/ul>

      Benefits<\/strong><\/h2>
      • Work-Life-Balance:<\/strong> Freuen Sie sich auf geregelte Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag <\/li>
      • Zentrale Lage<\/strong>: Betreuung eines fest zugeteilten B\u00fcrogeb\u00e4udes in zentraler Lage mit guter Verkehrsanbindung<\/li>
      • Onboarding<\/strong>: Ihre erfahrenen Kollegen stehen Ihnen w\u00e4hrend der Einarbeitung mit Rat und Tat zur Seite<\/li>

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Position Summary

The Vice President, Major Accounts/Vice President Sales is a senior sales leader responsible for driving revenue growth through the acquisition of new national accounts and the expansion of existing major and strategic customer relationships. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role will lead the strategy and execution of Smart Care Solutions’ enterprise and national account sales initiatives, with direct accountability for developing new business, increasing share of wallet within existing customers, and securing long-term strategic partnerships.

This leader will identify, pursue, and close high-value commercial opportunities with large, multi-location organizations, including quick-service restaurants (QSR), full-service restaurants (FSR), and other customers with significant commercial foodservice equipment service needs. The role will develop executive-level customer relationships, lead complex sales pursuits and negotiations, and collaborate with operations and other internal stakeholders to deliver scalable, profitable service solutions.

As a key member of the commercial organization, the Vice President, Major Accounts will partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer to execute growth priorities, strengthen Smart Care Solutions’ national market position, and deliver measurable results in revenue, account expansion, new customer acquisition, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth

  • Partner with the Chief Revenue Officer to develop and execute strategies for acquiring new national accounts and expanding existing major customer relationships.
  • Translate commercial growth objectives into actionable sales plans, account strategies, and measurable performance targets.
  • Own the major and national account sales pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of qualified opportunities and disciplined execution from prospecting through contract close.
  • Identify new markets, customer segments, and strategic opportunities that align with Smart Care Solutions’ capabilities and growth priorities.
  • Develop strategies to increase revenue, service penetration, contract value, and profitability across targeted accounts.
  • Provide the CRO with regular updates on sales performance, pipeline health, forecasted revenue, competitive activity, and progress against growth objectives.

National Account Acquisition and Business Development

  • Lead the pursuit and acquisition of high-value national and enterprise customers, with a focus on large, multi-location restaurant groups, QSR and FSR brands, franchise organizations, and other strategic commercial customers.
  • Develop and execute targeted prospecting strategies to engage senior decision-makers and build relationships with prospective national accounts.
  • Personally lead complex sales opportunities, including discovery, solution development, presentations, proposals, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline of strategic opportunities through executive networking, industry relationships, referrals, market intelligence, and proactive business development.
  • Position Smart Care Solutions as a preferred service partner by demonstrating the value of its service capabilities, geographic reach, technical expertise, and ability to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with senior executives, procurement leaders, facilities executives, and operations decision-makers at targeted organizations.

Major Account Expansion and Strategic Growth

  • Drive incremental revenue within existing major accounts by expanding service agreements, increasing service penetration, and securing business across additional locations, regions, brands, and business units.
  • Develop strategic growth plans for key accounts, identifying opportunities to increase customer value, strengthen relationships, and capture additional business.
  • Lead executive-level business reviews focused on account performance, customer priorities, service opportunities, and future growth.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the scope of existing agreements and develop broader, long-term commercial partnerships.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to address customer needs, resolve escalated commercial issues, and protect account retention and profitability.

Commercial Negotiations and Account Economics

  • Lead complex national account negotiations, including pricing, contract terms, service-level commitments, and multi-location agreements.
  • Develop commercially sound proposals that balance customer requirements, competitive positioning, service delivery capabilities, and profitability.
  • Partner with finance and operations to evaluate deal economics, pricing assumptions, implementation requirements, and financial risks before committing to significant customer agreements.
  • Ensure national account opportunities meet established financial and commercial objectives.
  • Maintain executive-level relationships throughout the sales process and serve as a senior commercial representative for Smart Care Solutions.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with operations, regional leadership, service delivery, finance, and other internal teams to develop solutions that can be executed consistently across the required geographic footprint.
  • Align customer commitments with operational capabilities, technician capacity, service coverage, and implementation requirements.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support national account onboarding, service expansion, and successful execution of customer agreements.
  • Provide customer and market insights to the CRO and broader leadership team to inform commercial planning and business development priorities.

Sales Performance and Accountability

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators for new account acquisition, revenue growth, existing account expansion, pipeline development, sales conversion, and profitability.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and communicate risks, opportunities, and expected results to the CRO.
  • Evaluate performance against established objectives and implement strategies to address gaps in pipeline coverage, conversion, or account growth.
  • Develop scalable sales processes and best practices for national account prospecting, strategic selling, negotiation, and account expansion.
  • Deliver measurable results against agreed-upon commercial objectives and contribute to Smart Care Solutions’ overall revenue growth strategy.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive sales experience, including leadership responsibility for major accounts, enterprise sales, national account acquisition, or strategic business development.
  • Demonstrated success personally winning large, complex accounts and generating meaningful revenue growth.
  • Proven ability to expand existing customer relationships while consistently developing new business opportunities.
  • Experience selling business-to-business services, service agreements, facilities services, commercial equipment services, or other solutions to large enterprise customers strongly preferred.
  • Experience serving multi-location customers in the restaurant, foodservice, hospitality, facilities management, commercial equipment, or field service industries is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers and lead complex commercial negotiations.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including pricing strategy, contract profitability, forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • Experience collaborating with operations and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute commercially viable customer solutions.
  • Strong executive communication, strategic planning, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support customer development, executive relationships, and national account growth.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Converts commercial objectives into focused sales strategies and measurable business results.
  • Hunter Mentality: Proactively identifies, pursues, and closes high-value new business opportunities.
  • Enterprise Account Growth: Expands strategic relationships, increases service penetration, and grows long-term account value.
  • Executive Influence: Establishes credibility with senior customer leaders and internal executives.
  • Commercial Acumen: Balances revenue growth, pricing, customer value, and profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Aligns internal teams to deliver customer commitments and profitable growth.
  • Accountability and Execution: Maintains disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, and consistent delivery against targets.

Measures of Success

  • Revenue generated from newly acquired national and strategic accounts.
  • Revenue growth and increased service penetration within existing major accounts.
  • Growth in qualified national account pipeline and conversion of opportunities into executed agreements.
  • Contract profitability and contribution to overall commercial objectives.
  • Expansion of Smart Care Solutions’ relationships with large, multi-location customers.
  • Strength of executive-level customer relationships and long-term account retention.
  • Accuracy of sales forecasting and consistent achievement of agreed-upon growth targets.

About Smart Care

Smart Care is a national repair and service provider for commercial foodservice, refrigeration, and cold storage equipment. Our offering of comprehensive mechanical services includes hot side cooking equipment, stand-alone refrigeration, specialty coffee and beverage, complex rack refrigeration and HVAC.

Smart Care is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected class status. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need a reasonable accommodation with respect to Smart Care’s application or hiring process due to a disability, please contact the Human Resources department at .

At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.
The Privacy Program Optimization Manager is responsible for the engagement health and realized value of Bluesight's PrivacyPro customer portfolio. PrivacyPro helps health systems detect and investigate inappropriate access to patient records, but the product only delivers value when privacy teams actively work their cases, tune their monitoring, and embed PrivacyPro into their compliance workflows. This role exists to make sure that happens across every account, not just the ones that ask for help.

You will own the full book of business at the cohort level: monitoring engagement and program performance across all PrivacyPro customers, identifying accounts drifting toward disengagement before they become renewal risks, and directing the right resource (yourself, a Professional Services specialist, or a Customer Success Manager) to get them back on track. You will also build and run the reporting cadence that keeps our internal teams aligned, including a recurring executive summary and regular updates to CSMs on their accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with hands-on experience running or supporting a healthcare privacy or compliance program. Credentials such as CHPC, CHC, CIPP/US, or RHIA are highly desirable. You can balance portfolio-level oversight with hands-on customer work, and you are comfortable being the subject matter expert in the room with a privacy officer, a compliance investigator, or a chief compliance officer.

Core Responsibilities

    Portfolio & Cohort Management: Own engagement health across the full PrivacyPro customer base. Maintain a portfolio view of which accounts are actively working the product, which are drifting, and which need intervention, and make sure every at-risk account has a named owner and a plan.
    Engagement Metrics & Reporting: Define and maintain the PrivacyPro engagement scorecard (e.g., case review activity, alert response and closure rates, active user trends, workflow adherence). Publish a recurring executive flash summarizing portfolio health, and send regular account-level updates to CSMs so nothing surprises them at renewal.
    Proactive Account Intervention: For accounts missing the mark, run the play: diagnose the gap, re-engage the customer directly or deploy the right internal expert, and establish recurring touchpoints (monthly calls, best-practice reviews) until the account is back on track.
    Professional Services Orchestration: Direct traffic for the privacy Professional Services team's flexible capacity. Proactively scope and assign timeboxed engagements (workflow reviews, case investigation support, privacy health checkups) against the accounts that need them most, alongside the existing CSM-initiated request channel.
    CS & Sales Enablement: Arm CSMs and Account Managers with engagement and adoption context ahead of QBRs, EBRs, and renewal conversations. Flag accounts that are healthy enough for expansion conversations, and be honest about the ones that are not.
    Best Practices & Thought Leadership: Develop and maintain the PrivacyPro Engagement Playbook covering cadences, intervention plays, and communication templates. Lead webinars and customer-facing content that raise the bar on privacy program maturity across the customer base.
    Voice of the Customer: Represent privacy program challenges, workflow friction, and adoption gaps to Product and Engineering, particularly where they affect renewal or expansion risk.

Qualifications

    Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor's degree in health information management, healthcare administration, compliance, or a related field.
  • CHPC, CHC, CIPP/US, or RHIA credentials strongly preferred. Active involvement in privacy and compliance communities (e.g., AHIMA, HCCA) is a plus.

    • Experience

  • 5+ years in healthcare privacy, compliance, or health information management within a hospital or health system.
  • Direct experience running, supporting, or auditing a healthcare privacy program, including access monitoring, breach investigation, and HIPAA compliance workflows.
  • Familiarity with patient privacy monitoring technology, EHR audit logs and access controls, and HIPAA/HITECH regulatory requirements preferred.
  • Experience in customer engagement, account management, or implementation within healthcare or hospital systems.

    • Skills & Competencies

  • Proven ability to build credible relationships with privacy officers, compliance leaders, and health information management teams while delivering measurable value.
  • Strong data analysis skills: comfortable defining metrics, reading engagement dashboards, and turning trends into intervention plans.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills for both customer-facing and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.

Why Join Us

    Patient privacy violations erode trust, expose health systems to regulatory and legal risk, and harm the patients whose records are compromised, and most privacy programs are under-resourced for the volume of access they need to monitor. In this role you will directly raise the effectiveness of privacy monitoring across a national portfolio of health systems while shaping how Bluesight scales proactive customer engagement across its product lines. You will work alongside privacy SME-led Professional Services experts, an established Customer Success organization, and a proven engagement playbook already delivering results in our CostCheck business.
This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.

Why Bluesight?

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!
-Competitive salary
-Time off when you need it – unlimited vacation days!
-Generous insurance coverage
-401k program with a company match
-Fun, collaborative culture!

We are looking for an experienced Technical Solutions Architect to design and govern enterprise-grade application architectures spanning cloud platforms, integration ecosystems, data domains, and large business application portfolios. Job Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.

Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.

Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.

Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.

Develop analytics capabilities for:

Underwriting and risk selection

Claims and loss analysis

Pricing and profitability

Customer segmentation and retention

Fraud detection

Risk and capital analytics

Portfolio and investment performance

Asset allocation

Market and investment research

Financial forecasting

Regulatory and management reporting

Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.

Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.

Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.

Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.

Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.

Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.

Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.

Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.

Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.

Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.

Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.

7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.

Previous experience as:

Chief Analytics Officer

Chief Data & Analytics Officer

Chief Data Officer

Head of Data & Analytics

Head of Analytics

Group Head of Analytics

Director of Data & Analytics

Analytics Director

VP Data & Analytics

Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.

Strong understanding of:

Advanced analytics

Predictive modelling

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Statistical modelling

Data visualization

Scenario/stress testing

Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.

Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.

Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.

Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Prattville, AL

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

We are currently seeking an Associate Information Data Architect to join our organization in our Worcester, MA office or remote work arrangement.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Associate Information Data Architect plays a key role in delivering trusted, high quality analytics, data products, and insights that support strategic and operational decision making across the organization. Working within a modern Azure-based data ecosystem (ADF, Synapse, ADLS, Azure SQL, Python), this role transforms complex data into curated datasets, automated reporting, and actionable intelligence for teams across a wide range of business domains.

The Associate Information Data Architect collaborates with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable analytical solutions; design and govern KPI logic; validate data quality; and support both legacy (Informatica) and cloud native data platforms. Success in this role requires the ability to conceptualize solutions end-to-end, innovate within evolving cloud and data environments, drive results under tight timelines, build consensus across diverse stakeholders, and communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and business audiences.

This a full time, exempt position.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

Analytical & Architectural Responsibilities

  • Translate reporting and analytical requirements into analytical datasets, metric definitions, and reporting solutions.
  • Design and document source to target mappings, transformation logic, and data lineage for cross-system integrations.
  • Conduct deep dive data analysis to validate logic, resolve discrepancies, and support modernization or migration initiatives.
  • Respond to ad hoc and urgent requests by delivering accurate, timely information in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate complex data concepts clearly through written and verbal channels for both technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborate with product owners to define and document KPIs, metric logic, and shared business rules.

Technical & Data Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain curated analytics datasets (SQL views, tables, semantic layers) for dashboards and self-service analytics.
  • Perform data profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation using SQL and Python to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Parse, transform, and validate XML/JSON using Python, XPath, and schema rules; ensure consistency across systems.
  • Maintain source to target mappings supporting Azure Data Factory, Synapse, and Informatica workflows.
  • Improve analytics performance through query optimization, semantic modeling, and scalable dataset design.
  • Support data governance through documentation, lineage tracking, and adherence to data management standards.

Cloud & Platform Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to translate requirements into cloud-based data pipelines (ADF, Synapse, Informatica).
  • Work with architecture and engineering teams to align datasets with enterprise data models and Azure standards.
  • Support Azure and Fabric monitoring (pipeline health, data freshness, validation checks) to ensure SLA adherence.
  • Validate and analyze data stored in ADLS containers, ensuring correct structure and schema.
  • Work with Delta Lake and Parquet files to perform integrity checks and ensure consistency across storage layers.
  • Conduct reconciliation and quality verification as data moves through cloud storage zones.

Collaboration

  • Contribute to tool enhancements, process improvements, and innovation initiatives.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).
  • 2+ years of experience in a related field such as data engineering, ETL, data modeling, analysis, validation, reporting, or analytical solution delivery.
  • Strong proficiency with SQL for data analysis, data profiling and quality with large and complex datasets.
  • P&C insurance experience is strongly preferred, including understanding of operational and financial metrics.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Advanced Excel, Power BI and other visualization tools; ability to translate data into meaningful insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Knowledge of technical mapping, including database schema, XML schema, and JSON schema.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse (SQL & Spark), ADLS, Azure SQL, and Azure DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Python experience for data wrangling, XML/JSON parsing, XPath, automation, and validation.
  • Experience creating semantic models and analytical datasets for BI platforms.
  • Understanding of KPI design, data governance, lineage, and business glossary concepts.
  • Ability to work across legacy (Informatica) and cloud platforms and validate logic during migrations.
  • Ability to plan for future capability needs and continuous improvements.

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Data quality frameworks and automated testing with SQL/Python.
  • Synapse Spark / PySpark; Delta Lake and notebook development.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (datasets, pipelines, governance).
  • Exposure to Microsoft Purview or similar metadata/lineage tools.
  • Experience with Parquet, partitioning, and performance optimization in lakehouse architectures.
  • Exposure to Azure DevOps CI/CD (YAML, Git branching).
  • Exposure to Event streaming (Event Hubs, Service Bus) and APIs/Web Services (REST/SOAP).

CAREER DEVELOPMENT:

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

45K - 65K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Manager, TMVR Imaging Analysis


Working at Abbott


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.
  • undefined

The Opportunity


This position can be either remote or work out of our St Paul, MN location, supporting our Structural Heart medical device division.


Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by designing and providing device and management solutions for treating structural heart disease.


As the TMVR Imaging Analysis Manager, you will lead the team that conducts imaging analysis in support of the patient selection and screening processes for clinical studies associated with Abbott Structural Heart Devices and Products, particularly Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement (TMVR). The incumbent will work closely within the internal clinical study team, including the clinical science, project management, field clinical affairs, medical affairs, biostatistics, study management, and data management, as well as with external investigators. This position will have significant interaction with executive leadership, physician investigators and clinical operations teams.


What You’ll Work On

  • Patient screening and selection for first-in-class Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement (TMVR) clinical studies
  • Developing the required patient specific analysis to enable patient selection for TMVR studies, based on complex review of medical imaging data, as well as other materials to support trial enrollments.
  • Independently owning the image analysis process, end-to-end, from image acquisition to final patient suitability recommendations
  • Proactively and critically examining ways to enhance overall clinical trial performance nationally and internationally.
  • Providing ongoing feedback concerning all aspects of study screening experience for the purpose of developing and implementing strategies that will contribute to organizational and corporate goals and objectives.
  • Collaborating with the internal core clinical study team and clinical sites to share best practices and develop capabilities to optimize patient screening and selection processes.
  • Complying with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments.
  • Assisting with design, development, and monitoring of clinical evaluation projects.
  • Mentoring and training image analysis team members to increase team productivity and achieve goals.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelors’ degree in life sciences or related field
  • Minimum 8 years related clinical and/or medical industry work experience with in-depth knowledge of structural heart, cardiology, cardiovascular surgery, and/or critical care medicine.
  • Strong working knowledge in heart valve replacement and repair, transcatheter structural heart technologies, computed tomography, echocardiography, cardiovascular hemodynamics, and heart failure medicine.
  • Significant experience utilizing image viewing and processing software for computed tomography (CT) and/or echocardiographic analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to solve problems independently by considering input from multiple stakeholders
  • Ability to both lead a team and act as a senior individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment. Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects
  • Demonstrated skill and tactfulness in working as a cross-functional team member.
  • Experience in clinical research studies collaborating with cross-functional clinical research partners, physicians, and other healthcare providers
  • Well-organized and self-motivated with an ability to initiate and follow through on assignments.
  • Key attributes considered necessary for success:
    • Ability to work collaboratively, internally and externally
    • Ability to manage/prioritize multiple tasks and adapt to a changing, fast-paced environment
    • Ability to work in a group environment
    • Ability to drive effective communication with a cross-functional team
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Highly analytical
    • Strong interpersonal skills including influencing, negotiation and teamwork skills

. Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant experience working in a clinical setting and being integrally involved in delivering care directly to patients
  • A medical degree (e.g. Nursing, physician’s assistant, or MD) preferred

Designed for flexibility and long-term growth, our platform supports organizations operating in complex and regulated environments.

Position Summary

We are hiring several Software Developers across our product and platform teams. This posting spans intermediate to senior levels. Final level and team placement will be determined during the interview process based on demonstrated experience, strengths, and business needs.

AI is now a standard part of modern software development. At Modular Solutions, we expect engineers to be comfortable using generative AI tools as part of their daily workflow and to apply strong judgment when reviewing and validating outputs.

Some team members will focus on building production-grade AI-powered capabilities, including LLM integrations and retrieval-based workflows. Others will build core platform features that integrate with and extend these AI services. All developers are expected to collaborate across teams and contribute to high-quality, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate in an Agile Scrum environment, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to deliver features that drive measurable business value.
  • Participate in full SDLC activities, including research, estimation, proofs of concept, code reviews, deployments, and documentation.
  • Write high-quality, performant, testable, and maintainable code.
  • Maintain and develop robust backend systems and REST APIs using .NET Core and Entity Framework, with a strong emphasis on scalability, configurability, and clean service boundaries.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Design and implement extensible integration patterns that enable seamless connectivity with third-party systems and services.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable, cloud-native systems on Azure with a focus on reliability, performance, and observability.
  • Contribute to a domain-driven architecture where flexibility, versioning, extensibility, and long-term maintainability are core design principles.
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, well-documented, production-grade APIs intended for public or partner consumption. This includes thoughtful versioning strategies, backward compatibility considerations, and API lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to AI-powered features where appropriate, including LLM-based workflows and retrieval-driven functionality.
  • Use and evaluate AI developer tooling, including Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools as part of daily development workflows. We support flexibility and allow developers to use tools and environments that help them work effectively while maintaining engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

  • A degree, diploma, or certificate in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 or more years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core.
  • Experience building modern front-end applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, patterns, and clean architecture practices.
  • Comfortable using generative AI developer tools to improve productivity and quality while applying sound engineering judgment and validation practices.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing modular, extensible systems in complex, domain-driven applications where business logic is dynamic and highly configurable.
  • Experience designing clean, maintainable APIs with thoughtful versioning and long-term evolution in mind.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure.
  • Experience building production LLM-powered systems, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and agent-style workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern AI orchestration and agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar tooling.
  • Experience integrating LLM systems into production applications with attention to observability, evaluation, guardrails, and performance considerations.
  • Familiarity with the insurance industry or other complex, regulated business domains is an asset.

Our Technology Stack and Architecture

We primarily build using C# and .NET Core on the backend, with Entity Framework and PostgreSQL for data persistence. Our front-end applications are built with React and TypeScript. We leverage Azure for cloud infrastructure and operate in a service-oriented architecture with well-defined boundaries and clean API contracts.

Our systems are designed around modular, highly configurable components rather than tightly coupled implementations. We emphasize separation of concerns, clean code practices, and maintainable service boundaries. As the platform evolves, we prioritize scalability, observability, and long-term architectural integrity.

Why Join Modular Solutions

We are building a long-term platform in a complex industry. That means solving real architectural problems and delivering software that customers depend on every day. We value engineers who take pride in their work, write clean and well-tested code, and take the time to build things the right way. If you care about quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability, you will find meaningful work here.

We operate as a distributed team, with a preference for Alberta-based employees. We collaborate daily across product, engineering, and domain experts, and we come together periodically for in-person planning and team events. We value autonomy, accountability, and engineers who take ownership of their work.

You will be joining a team that treats software development as a craft, embraces modern tooling, including AI-assisted workflows, and takes pride in building production-grade systems the right way.

What We Offer

  • Be part of a growing company building a modern, enterprise-grade platform for the insurance industry.
  • Work alongside experienced insurance and technology professionals in a collaborative environment.
  • Flexible remote work environment, with a preference for Alberta-based team members, and periodic in-person planning sessions and team events.
  • Extended health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program.
  • Annual professional development allowance.
  • Additional paid time off beyond standard statutory holidays and vacation.
  • Recognition for meaningful contributions and career milestones.
  • Share Appreciation Rights program so you participate in the company’s long-term success.

To Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and what excites you about this opportunity. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team certified as a Great Place to Work and ranked #4 out of 15 Best Workplaces in Technology in the GCC, with regional offices in Dubai, Lviv, Ann Arbor, and London. Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Product Manager to support the Product Director across the full product lifecycle. You will run and manage product meetings, turn ideas and discussions into clear, well-written user stories, create mockups with the help of modern AI tools, and keep everyone informed on the status of upcoming releases.

The ideal candidate combines strong product craft with genuine design sensibility and a solid technical foundation: you can follow engineering discussions with ease, reason about APIs and architecture, and dig into technical details when the situation calls for it. The stronger your technical depth, the better. Key Responsibilities

  • Release Communication: Track release progress across engineering and QA, and proactively inform stakeholders of status, risks, and timelines.

  • AI-Assisted Design: Create wireframes and mockups using AI design and prototyping tools, and apply a strong eye for UI/UX to keep the product intuitive and polished (you will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview)

Requirements

  • Tools & Ecosystems: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with Linear (or a similar agile tracking tool), GitHub, and Claude (CLI and app) or comparable AI tooling

  • Design Literacy: Strong eye for design, foundational knowledge of UI/UX workflows, and proven ability to produce mockups with AI-assisted tools

  • Technical Foundation: A solid technical background with strong software development familiarity; able to hold your own in discussions about APIs, web technologies, and architecture with engineers. Deeper hands-on experience, such as with JavaScript/React or the Microsoft 365/SharePoint ecosystem, is a significant advantage

  • Include the word 'compass' in your application response to confirm you have read this posting carefully.

  • Big Plus: A Claude Code or Codex project of your own that you can showcase and explain in the interview

  • Location: Fully remote role; work from anywhere with reasonable overlap with the team

Highlights

Help us build our product the AI-native way: user stories in Linear, AI-assisted mockups, releases on track, with Claude in your daily toolkit. Fully remote, 4-day week, Great Place to Work certified.
